metadata.description: Keep your Mac awake for a set time or until you stop it. By default it also nudges the cursor once you go idle, so chat apps don't mark you Away. Start a session, come back later and run Stop. CLI/desktop only.

installHints.macos: built into macOS — nothing to install
built into macOS — activity simulation needs Accessibility permission for your terminal app

parameters.script:
# keep-awake: a background caffeinate session you start, check and stop.
# $1 bnto home, $2 action, $3 duration (seconds | inf),
# $4 display (keep-on | allow-sleep), $5 activity simulation (idle seconds | off).
die() { echo "keep-awake: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
home=$1 action=$2 duration=$3 display=$4 jiggle=$5
[ -n "$home" ] || die "bnto home is unknown"
case $action in start | stop | status) ;; *) die "unknown action '$action'" ;; esac
# A leading zero would make sh's arithmetic read the duration as octal.
case $duration in inf) ;; '' | 0* | *[!0-9]*) die "bad duration '$duration'" ;; esac
case $display in keep-on | allow-sleep) ;; *) die "bad display setting '$display'" ;; esac
case $jiggle in off) ;; '' | *[!0-9]*) die "bad idle threshold '$jiggle'" ;; esac

state_dir="$home/state"
state="$state_dir/keep-awake.json"

# JXA helper, one entry point per mode, values via its own argv:
#   trusted         -- does the terminal have Accessibility permission?
#   idle            -- seconds since the last keyboard/mouse input
#   loop SECS UNTIL -- nudge the cursor 1px whenever idle >= SECS, until
#                      UNTIL (epoch seconds, 0 = forever)
# A posted mouse move resets the system idle timer; caffeinate alone does
# not, which is why chat apps still go Away during a plain caffeinate session.
# shellcheck disable=SC2016 # JavaScript, not shell: nothing should expand.
JXA='ObjC.import("CoreGraphics"); ObjC.import("ApplicationServices");
function idle() { return $.CGEventSourceSecondsSinceLastEventType($.kCGEventSourceStateHIDSystemState, 0xFFFFFFFF); }
function move(x, y) { $.CGEventPost($.kCGHIDEventTap, $.CGEventCreateMouseEvent($(), $.kCGEventMouseMoved, {x: x, y: y}, 0)); }
function nudge() { var p = $.CGEventGetLocation($.CGEventCreate($())); move(p.x + 1, p.y); delay(0.15); move(p.x, p.y); }
function run(argv) {
  if (argv[0] === "trusted") return String($.AXIsProcessTrusted());
  if (argv[0] === "idle") return String(Math.round(idle()));
  var threshold = Number(argv[1]), ends = Number(argv[2]);
  while (!ends || Date.now() / 1000 < ends) { delay(15); if (idle() >= threshold) nudge(); }
}'
jxa() { /usr/bin/osascript -l JavaScript -e "$JXA" "$@"; }

# One field from the state file this script writes below.
field() { [ -f "$state" ] && sed -n "s/.*\"$1\": *\"*\([^,\"}]*\).*/\1/p" "$state"; }

# False once a timed session's end has passed: its caffeinate has exited by
# then, so whatever runs at that pid now is another program's.
current_state() {
  end=$(field until)
  end=${end%.*}
  case $end in '') return 0 ;; *[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  [ "$end" -gt "$(date +%s)" ]
}

# Print pid $1 if it still runs the command this script started as $2
# (session | nudger), so a stale pid now used by another program doesn't count.
ours() {
  case $1 in '' | *[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  current_state || return 1
  args=$(ps -ww -p "$1" -o args= 2>/dev/null) || return 1
  case $2:$args in
    session:"/usr/bin/caffeinate -i -s -t "* | session:"/usr/bin/caffeinate -du -i -s -t "*) echo "$1" ;;
    nudger:"/usr/bin/osascript -l JavaScript -e "*" loop "*) echo "$1" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

session_pid() { ours "$(field pid)" session; }
jiggle_pid() { ours "$(field jigglePid)" nudger; }

# End the session and its nudger, each only if it's still ours: either can
# outlive the other (say, after `killall caffeinate`).
end_session() {
  s=$(session_pid) j=$(jiggle_pid)
  if [ -n "$s" ]; then kill "$s" 2>/dev/null; fi
  if [ -n "$j" ]; then kill "$j" 2>/dev/null; fi
  rm -f "$state"
}

remaining() {
  ends=$(field until)
  if [ -z "$ends" ]; then echo "running indefinitely"; return; fi
  # Round up, so a fresh 30-minute session reads 30m, not 29m.
  m=$(( (${ends%.*} - $(date +%s) + 59) / 60 ))
  if [ "$m" -lt 0 ]; then m=0; fi
  printf '%dh %02dm remaining of %s\n' $((m / 60)) $((m % 60)) "$(field label)"
}

plural() { if [ "$1" = 1 ]; then echo "1 $2"; else echo "$1 ${2}s"; fi; }

label_for() {
  if [ "$1" = inf ]; then echo "indefinitely"; return; fi
  h=$(($1 / 3600)) m=$(($1 % 3600 / 60))
  if [ "$h" = 0 ]; then
    plural "$m" minute
  elif [ "$m" = 0 ]; then
    plural "$h" hour
  else
    echo "$(plural "$h" hour) $(plural "$m" minute)"
  fi
}

current=$(session_pid)
nudger=$(jiggle_pid)

if [ "$action" = stop ]; then
  if [ -n "$current$nudger" ]; then
    end_session
    echo "Session ended -- your Mac can sleep normally again."
  else
    rm -f "$state"
    echo "No active session -- nothing to stop."
  fi
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$action" = status ]; then
  if [ -z "$current" ]; then
    echo "No active session."
    if [ -n "$nudger" ]; then echo "Activity simulation is still running -- run Stop to end it."; fi
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "Session active -- $(remaining)."
  if [ -z "$(field jigglePid)" ]; then
    sim=off
  elif [ -n "$nudger" ]; then
    sim=on
  else
    sim="stopped -- start a new session to restart it"
  fi
  echo "Activity simulation: $sim"
  echo "Idle for $(jxa idle)s right now."
  exit 0
fi

# --- start ---
mkdir -p "$state_dir" || die "can't create $state_dir"
replaced=""
if [ -n "$current$nudger" ]; then replaced="Replaced previous session -- "; fi
end_session

label=$(label_for "$duration")
if [ "$duration" = inf ]; then
  secs=315360000 ends=0
else
  secs=$duration ends=$(( $(date +%s) + duration ))
fi

set -- -i -s -t "$secs"
# -d keeps the display awake; -u declares the user active, waking it if off.
if [ "$display" = keep-on ]; then set -- -du "$@"; fi
# Detached with stdio closed, so bnto sees the step finish right away.
nohup /usr/bin/caffeinate "$@" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
extra=", \"pid\": $!"
if [ "$ends" != 0 ]; then extra="$extra, \"until\": $ends"; fi

warning=""
if [ "$jiggle" = off ]; then
  sim=off
elif [ "$(jxa trusted)" = true ]; then
  nohup /usr/bin/osascript -l JavaScript -e "$JXA" loop "$jiggle" "$ends" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  extra="$extra, \"jigglePid\": $!"
  sim="on (nudges the cursor after ${jiggle}s idle)"
else
  sim=off
  warning="
WARNING: activity simulation needs Accessibility permission -- chat apps will still mark you Away.
  Grant it to your terminal app: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility"
fi

printf '{"label": "%s"%s}\n' "$label" "$extra" >"$state"

if [ "$duration" = inf ]; then what="indefinitely (until you stop it)"; else what="for $label"; fi
echo "${replaced}Session started: staying awake $what."
echo "Activity simulation: $sim"
echo "Run keep-awake again with Action: Stop to end it early.$warning"

action.label: Action
action.description: Start a new session, stop the running one, or check what's currently active.

duration.label: Session Length
duration.description: How long to stay awake. Ignored for Stop and Check status.

display.label: Display
display.description: Keep the display awake so it doesn't sleep. Allow sleep if you only need background tasks to keep running.

jiggle.label: Activity Simulation
jiggle.description: Keeping the Mac awake doesn't reset the system idle timer, so chat apps still mark you Away. This nudges the cursor 1px once you've been idle this long. Needs Accessibility permission for your terminal app.
